_note: 遊戲 3（石壁山嶺）分兩節：第 1 節＝集隊手號（斷崖機關，兩階段：翻卡學手號，在打數之內按下相應隊形）；第 2 節＝步操動作（山下閱兵場，三階段：先翻動作卡學口令、打數與要點，再在口令機關限時按下正確動作；每段累積混合之前學過的動作）。第 2 節三段為：立正／稍息／敬禮；四方向移步＋左轉／右轉／後轉；原地踏步／齊步／停步／看齊。兩節完成才記錄「已學完」，之後找領袖親身考核並輸入代碼（預設 82DR）。資料來源：香港童軍總會《步操手冊》；集隊手號以領袖石雕像圖顯示，步操動作以手冊原頁及動作示意圖顯示。領袖可自行修改此檔文字與題目，任務以資料庫為準、此檔為預設。
source_zh: 香港童軍總會《步操手冊》
source_en: The Scout Association of Hong Kong — Drill Manual

paras_zh: 隊伍來到石壁山嶺的斷崖前。下山的路早就塌了，只剩崖壁上一排古老機關——石上刻著做集隊手號的人像。
在打數之內按下相應的隊形，機關就會啟動，石級一段一段現身。兩段石階齊了，就能落到山下的閱兵場，開始第 2 節：翻卡學步操口令、打數和動作要點，再聽口令按出正確動作。
paras_en: The troop reaches the cliff of the rocky ridge. The way down collapsed long ago — all that is left is a row of ancient mechanisms on the rock face, carved with a scout making the fall-in hand signs.

Press the matching formation inside the count and a mechanism wakes, sliding a flight of steps out of the rock. With both flights out, climb down to the parade ground for section 2: study the drill commands, counts and movement points on the cards, then press the right movement when the command is called.
intro.hint_zh: 第 1 節集隊手號兩階段；第 2 節步操動作三階段。每階段先翻卡學習，再在打數之內完成機關。
intro.hint_en: Section 1 has two hand-sign stages; section 2 has three drill-movement stages. Study the cards first in every stage, then answer inside the count.

animation.label_zh: 1 · 稍息起步：雙腳分開，雙手在身後
animation.label_en: 1 · Start at stand at ease: feet apart, hands behind the back

animation.label_zh: 2 · 左腳提起至中途，雙手由身後回到兩側
animation.label_en: 2 · Lift the left foot halfway; bring both hands from behind the back to the sides

animation.label_zh: 3 · 左大腿與地面平行，雙手回到兩側握拳
animation.label_en: 3 · Left thigh level with the ground; both hands return to the sides as fists

animation.label_zh: 4 · 左腳落至接近地面，準備靠攏右腳
animation.label_en: 4 · Lower the left foot close to the ground, ready to close beside the right

animation.label_zh: 5 · 左腳踏下靠攏右腳，握拳貼褲縫，成立正
animation.label_en: 5 · Place the left foot beside the right, fists at the seams — Alert

points_zh: 起步為稍息：雙腳分開 305 毫米（12 吋），雙手在身後中央
聽到「Alert!」：提起左腳至大腿與地面平行，左小腿放鬆；雙手同時沿身體回到兩側握拳
左腳踏下並靠攏右腳，雙腳平放地面，腳尖向外分開，與中線成 30 度角
雙膝伸直，身體保持挺直；雙拳放於褲縫之後，拇指指甲向前
下顎緊貼衣領，眼望無限遠
points_en: Start at stand at ease: feet 305 mm (12 in) apart, hands in the centre of the back
On “Alert!” lift the left foot until the thigh is level, lower leg relaxed; at the same time bring both hands back to the sides as fists
Place the left foot down beside the right; feet flat, toes turned out 30 degrees from the centre line
Knees straight, body upright, fists behind the trouser seams with the thumbnails forward
Chin in to the collar, eyes looking to the far distance
moves.note_zh: 典禮中聽到的 Attention / Squad Shun / Parade Shun 與立正（Alert）動作相同。
moves.note_en: Attention / Squad Shun / Parade Shun (used in ceremonies) is the same position as Alert.

check.q_zh: 立正時，腳尖向外分開與中線成多少度？
check.q_en: At the position of attention, how far are the toes turned out?
check.why_zh: 手冊：腳尖向外分開與中線成 30 度角。
check.why_en: Manual: toes 30 degrees from the centre line.

animation.label_zh: 1 · 立正起步：雙腳靠攏，雙拳貼褲縫
animation.label_en: 1 · Start at Alert: feet together, fists at the seams

animation.label_zh: 2 · 左腳開始提起，左小腿放鬆
animation.label_en: 2 · Begin lifting the left foot, lower leg relaxed

animation.label_zh: 3 · 左腳提起至中途
animation.label_en: 3 · Lift the left foot halfway

animation.label_zh: 4 · 左大腿與地面平行，左小腿放鬆
animation.label_en: 4 · Left thigh level with the ground, lower leg relaxed

animation.label_zh: 5 · 左腳向外落下，雙手同時移至身後
animation.label_en: 5 · Lower the left foot outward as both hands move behind the back

animation.label_zh: 6 · 左腳接近地面，準備向外踏下
animation.label_en: 6 · Left foot close to the ground, ready to step out

animation.label_zh: 7 · 左腳踏下，雙腳分開，雙手在身後中央，成稍息
animation.label_en: 7 · Place the left foot down, feet apart and hands behind the back — stand at ease

points_zh: 由立正：提起左腳直至大腿與地面平行，然後向外踏下
雙腳分開 305 毫米（12 吋），約與肩膊同寬
雙手沿身體向後移至身後中央，由拳變掌，右掌疊於左掌上
雙手拇指緊扣；頭部保持立正向前姿勢
points_en: From attention: lift the left foot until the thigh is level, then place it down to the side
Feet 305 mm (12 in) apart, about shoulder width
Hands move to the centre of the back, opening from fists, right palm on the left
Thumbs locked together; head stays as at attention

check.q_zh: 稍息時雙腳分開多少？
check.q_en: How far apart are the feet at stand-at-ease?
check.why_zh: 手冊：雙腳分開 305 毫米（12 英吋），闊度約與肩膊相同。
check.why_en: Manual: feet 305 mm (12 in) apart, about shoulder width.

points_zh: 由稍息：雙手手指自然放鬆
身體其他部分與稍息完全相同
回復稍息的口令是「Squad!」，雙手手指用力拉緊放直
points_en: From stand-at-ease: relax the fingers
Everything else stays exactly as at stand-at-ease
The command to come back to stand-at-ease is "Squad!" — fingers pulled straight

check.q_zh: 由休息回復稍息的口令是甚麼？
check.q_en: Which command returns the squad from stand easy to stand at ease?
check.why_zh: 手冊：聽到 Squad! 雙手手指用力拉緊放直，回復稍息。
check.why_en: Manual: on "Squad!" the fingers are pulled straight again.

points_zh: 第一分部：微微提高右腳尖及左腳跟，以右腳掌及左腳尖為軸心，用頭、肩膊及身體的力量向右轉 90 度
第二分部：左腳提起並靠攏右腳，回復立正
轉動時雙膝保持伸直，上體保持立正姿勢
points_en: Squad one: raise the right toe and left heel slightly, pivot on them 90 degrees to the right
Squad two: lift the left foot and close in beside the right, back to attention
Knees stay straight; the body stays upright throughout

check.q_zh: 向右轉的打數是？
check.q_en: What is the count for the right turn?
check.why_zh: 手冊：向右轉打數 One—Two—Three—One。
check.why_en: Manual: the right turn is counted One—Two—Three—One.

points_zh: 與向右轉相同，方向相反：以左腳掌及右腳尖為軸心向左轉 90 度
第二分部：右腳提起並靠攏左腳，回復立正
points_en: As the right turn, in the opposite direction: pivot on the left ball and right toe 90 degrees left
Squad two: lift the right foot and close in beside the left

check.q_zh: 向左轉時，以哪裏為軸心？
check.q_en: What do you pivot on for a left turn?
options_en: Left ball of foot and right toe
Right ball of foot and left toe
check.why_zh: 手冊：以左腳掌及右腳尖為軸心向左轉 90 度。
check.why_en: Manual: pivot on the left ball of the foot and right toe.

points_zh: 與向右轉相同，但轉 180 度
以右腳掌及左腳尖為軸心，向右轉半圈
第二分部：左腳提起並靠攏右腳，回復立正
points_en: As the right turn, but through 180 degrees
Pivot on the right ball and left toe, half a circle to the right
Squad two: close the left foot in beside the right

check.q_zh: 後轉共轉多少度？
check.q_en: How many degrees is the about turn?
check.why_zh: 手冊：後轉即向右轉 180 度。
check.why_en: Manual: the about turn is 180 degrees.

sections.lead_zh: 宣誓禮儀的中心動作：右手舉起，指尖剛好在右眼對上。
sections.lead_en: The heart of the investiture customs: the right hand raised, fingertips just above the right eye.

moves.title_en: Saluting to the front at the halt

animation.label_zh: 1 · 立正起步：雙拳貼褲縫
animation.label_en: 1 · Start at Alert: both fists at the seams

animation.label_zh: 2 · Up：右手向橫提起
animation.label_en: 2 · Up: raise the right hand sideways

animation.label_zh: 3 · 右手提至與肩膊平，成童軍敬禮手勢
animation.label_en: 3 · Right hand at shoulder level, formed into the Scout salute

animation.label_zh: 4 · 右前臂用力舉起
animation.label_en: 4 · Force the right forearm upward

animation.label_zh: 5 · 食指在右眼上方，Two—Three 保持敬禮
animation.label_en: 5 · Forefinger above the right eye; hold on Two—Three

animation.label_zh: 6 · Down：右手由額前向前落下並握拳
animation.label_en: 6 · Down: bring the right hand down towards the front and close the fist

animation.label_zh: 7 · 右拳沿大腿前面落下，接近褲縫
animation.label_en: 7 · Lower the right fist down the front of the thigh, close to the seam

animation.label_zh: 8 · 右拳回到右褲縫，回復立正
animation.label_en: 8 · Right fist back at the right seam — Alert

points_zh: 第一分部（Up!）：右手向橫提升至與肩膊平，握成童軍敬禮手號，隨即儘快用力將右前臂舉起，至食指於右眼對上的位置
右手前臂與指尖成一直線；右食指放於右眼眼球中心上方 25 毫米（1 吋）位置
左手握拳緊貼褲縫，雙腳掌平放地面，雙膝直，身軀保持挺直向前
第二分部（Down!）：右手用最短距離握拳，放回右褲縫位置，回復立正
完整動作以每分鐘 40 個動作的停頓時距連貫完成；打數時 Two—Three 是停留時間，沒有動作
points_en: Squad one (Up!): the right hand is raised sideways to the shoulder, formed into the Scout salute, then smartly forced up until the forefinger is just above the right eye
The right forearm and fingertips are in one straight line; the forefinger rests 25 mm (1 in) above the centre of the right eye
Left fist at the trouser seam, feet flat, knees straight, body upright to the front
Squad two (Down!): the right hand returns as a fist by the shortest route to the right seam, back to attention
The whole movement flows at 40 movements to the minute; on the count Two—Three you hold still — no movement

check.q_zh: 敬禮時，右手食指應放在哪個位置？
check.q_en: When saluting, where does the right forefinger rest?
options_zh: 右眼眼球中心上方 25 毫米（1 吋）
options_en: 25 mm (1 in) above the centre of the right eye
In the middle of the forehead
check.why_zh: 手冊：右食指放於右眼眼球中心上方 25 毫米（1 英吋）位置。
check.why_en: Manual: the forefinger rests 25 mm (1 in) above the centre of the right eye.

points_zh: 聽口令向前移一步，身體保持正面向前及立正姿勢
只移一步；完成後雙腳回復立正位置
手冊未有前移步專頁：起步腳與收步節奏跟領袖示範練習
points_en: Move one pace forward, keeping the body square to the front at attention
One pace only; finish with the feet back in the attention position
The manual has no separate forward-pace page: the starting and closing feet follow the leader’s demonstration

check.q_zh: 前移一步後，身體應朝向哪個方向？
check.q_en: After one pace forward, which way should the body face?
check.why_zh: 前移一步只改變位置，身體保持正面向前。
check.why_en: One pace forward changes position only; the body stays square to the front.

points_zh: 聽口令向後移一步，頭和身體仍正面向前，不轉身
只移一步；完成後雙腳回復立正位置
手冊未有後移步專頁：起步腳與收步節奏跟領袖示範練習
points_en: Move one pace backward, keeping the head and body square to the front — do not turn around
One pace only; finish with the feet back in the attention position
The manual has no separate backward-pace page: the starting and closing feet follow the leader’s demonstration

check.q_zh: 後移一步時，要不要轉身向後？
check.q_en: When moving one pace backward, do you turn around?
options_zh: 不用，身體保持正面向前
options_en: No — stay square to the front
Yes — look backwards as you step
check.why_zh: 後移一步時身體保持正面向前，不用轉身。
check.why_en: For one pace backward the body stays square to the front.

points_zh: 第一分部：左腳向左邊橫移 300 毫米（12 吋），右腳保持原本位置
第二分部：提起右膝至大腿與地面平行，然後右腳踏在左腳旁，回復立正
雙腳掌平放地面，雙膝蹬直；左右手握拳緊貼褲縫，身體保持立正向前，不左右搖擺
points_en: Squad one: move the left foot 300 mm (12 in) to the left; the right foot stays
Squad two: raise the right knee until the thigh is level, then place the right foot beside the left at attention
Feet flat, knees straight, fists at the trouser seams, body square to the front without swaying

check.q_zh: 左移一步第一分部的距離是多少？
check.q_en: How far does the left foot move in squad one of one pace left close?
check.why_zh: 手冊：左腳向左邊橫移 300 毫米（12 英吋），然後右腳靠攏。
check.why_en: Manual: the left foot moves 300 mm (12 in), then the right foot closes in.

points_zh: 第一分部：右腳向右邊橫移 300 毫米（12 吋），左腳保持原本位置
第二分部：提起左膝至大腿與地面平行，然後左腳踏在右腳旁，回復立正
向右橫移與向左橫移動作相反；身體保持立正向前，不左右搖擺
points_en: Squad one: move the right foot 300 mm (12 in) to the right; the left foot stays
Squad two: raise the left knee until the thigh is level, then place the left foot beside the right at attention
The right close is the reverse of the left close; stay square to the front without swaying

check.q_zh: 右移一步第一分部，哪一隻腳先橫移？
check.q_en: In squad one of one pace right close, which foot moves first?
check.why_zh: 手冊：向右橫移與向左相反，右腳先向右橫移 300 毫米，左腳再靠攏。
check.why_en: Manual: the right close is the reverse of the left — right foot out 300 mm, then the left closes in.

points_zh: 左腳向前一步 750 毫米（30 吋），右手向前提升，左手拉後
雙臂自然擺動，前臂與地面成一直線，握拳
步速每分鐘 116 步
身軀保持挺直向前，眼望前方
points_en: The left foot steps forward 750 mm (30 in); the right arm swings forward, the left back
Arms swing naturally from the shoulder, fists clenched
Pace: 116 steps to the minute
Body upright, eyes to the front

check.q_zh: 齊步的步幅與步速是？
check.q_en: What is the step length and pace of the quick march?
options_zh: 750 毫米 · 每分鐘 116 步
300 毫米 · 每分鐘 100 步
750 毫米 · 每分鐘 140 步
check.why_zh: 手冊：開步 750 毫米（30 英吋），每分鐘 116 步。
check.why_en: Manual: a 750 mm (30 in) step at 116 paces to the minute.

points_zh: 口令在左腳落地時發出
右腳再向前一步 750 毫米（30 吋）
左腳提起並靠攏右腳，回復立正
動作要乾淨利落，不再向前衝
points_en: The command is given as the left foot strikes the ground
The right foot takes one more 750 mm (30 in) step
The left foot then closes in beside the right, back to attention
Finish crisp and still — no stumbling forward

check.q_zh: 聽到「Squad—halt!」後，還要走幾多步？
check.q_en: After "Squad—halt!", how many more steps are taken?
options_zh: 一步（右腳），然後左腳靠攏
options_en: One (right foot), then close in the left
check.why_zh: 手冊：右腳行前一步，左腳隨即靠攏成立正。
check.why_en: Manual: one more step with the right foot, then the left closes in.

points_zh: 左腳提高至大腿與地面平行，然後踏回右腳旁；右腳如是，左右交替
支撐的腳掌平放地面，膝頭直
左右手握拳緊貼褲縫
保持每分鐘 116 步的速度
停止：Squad—halt!；由行進轉踏步：Quick mark—time!
points_en: Lift the left foot until the thigh is level, place it back beside the right; alternate
The supporting foot stays flat, knee straight
Fists at the trouser seams
Keep up 116 steps to the minute
Halt: Squad—halt!; from the march: Quick mark—time!

check.q_zh: 原地踏步時，腳要提高到哪個位置？
check.q_en: How high is the foot lifted when marking time?
options_en: Until the thigh is level with the ground
check.why_zh: 手冊：要提高的腳必需提高至大腿與地面平行。
check.why_en: Manual: the thigh comes level with the ground.

sections.lead_zh: 司令先立正，發出口令「Scout Troop, Fall-in!」並用雙手做出手號；全隊排成所需隊形後保持立正，直至司令放下雙手，即轉稍息。手冊共有七類手號。
sections.lead_en: The commander comes to attention, calls "Scout Troop, Fall-in!" and makes the sign with both hands; the troop forms up and stands at attention until the commander drops their hands. The manual carries seven signs.

points_zh: 司令先立正，發出口令「Scout Troop, Fall-in!」，跟着用雙手做成手號
司令與最前的童軍相距 2250 毫米（90 吋）
全隊排成所需隊形後保持立正，直至司令放下雙手，全隊即由立正轉為稍息
排列時小隊長在隊的最右方、副小隊長在最左方（直行時小隊長在最前、副小隊長在最後）
points_en: The commander stands at attention, calls "Scout Troop, Fall-in!" and makes the sign
The commander stands 2250 mm (90 in) in front of the troop
The troop forms up and stays at attention until the commander drops their hands — then stands at ease
Patrol leaders stand on the right of each patrol, assistant patrol leaders on the left (in columns: front and rear)

check.q_zh: 司令放下雙手後，全隊由立正轉為甚麼姿勢？
check.q_en: When the commander drops their hands, what does the troop do?
options_en: From attention to stand at ease
check.why_zh: 手冊：全隊保持立正，直至司令放下雙手，立即由立正轉為稍息。
check.why_en: Manual: the troop stays at attention until the hands drop, then stands at ease.

points_zh: 手號：兩手握拳，向身旁兩側平舉，提升至與肩膊成一直線
全隊按分隊形式，在司令前 2250 毫米（90 吋）排成一直線
排列後隊形正中央的童軍面對司令
每名童軍相距 750 毫米（30 吋），每隊之間 1500 毫米（60 吋）
points_en: Sign: fists raised out to the sides, level with the shoulders in one line
The troop forms a single line 2250 mm (90 in) in front of the commander
The scout at the centre of the line faces the commander
Scouts 750 mm (30 in) apart; 1500 mm (60 in) between patrols

check.q_zh: 直線隊形中，每名童軍相距多少？
check.q_en: In a line, how far apart do scouts stand?
check.why_zh: 手冊：每名童軍相距 750 毫米（30 英吋）。
check.why_en: Manual: scouts stand 750 mm (30 in) apart.

moves.leader_zh: 直線正前方中央，正對中央的童軍
moves.leader_en: Front and centre of the line, facing the centre scout

points_zh: 手號：左（右）手握拳在面前舉起，前臂與手臂成 90 度，手背向前；右（左）手握拳向身旁一側提升至與肩膊成一直線
全隊按高至矮，在司令前 2250 毫米（90 吋）排成一直線
最高的童軍面對司令，其他依高矮次序排在其右（左）方
每名童軍相距 750 毫米（30 吋）
points_en: Sign: one fist held in front, forearm at 90 degrees, back of the hand forward; the other fist raised out to the side, level with the shoulder
The troop lines up tallest to shortest, 2250 mm (90 in) in front of the commander
The tallest scout faces the commander; the rest follow in height order to the right (left)
Scouts stand 750 mm (30 in) apart

check.q_zh: 直線（由高至矮）隊形中，哪一位面對司令？
check.q_en: In the tallest-first line, who faces the commander?
check.why_zh: 手冊：最高的童軍面對司令，其他依高矮次序排在其右（左）方。
check.why_en: Manual: the tallest scout faces the commander, the rest follow in height order.

moves.leader_zh: 最高童軍的正前方，正對最高童軍
moves.leader_en: Directly in front of the tallest scout, facing them

points_zh: 手號：兩手握拳向前提升至與肩齊，手背向天
以小隊為單位，小隊長在司令前 2250 毫米（90 吋）排成直行
小隊長在前方，副小隊長在最後方；每名童軍前後相距 750 毫米（30 吋）
第二隊在第一隊的左方，隊與隊之間相距 750 毫米（30 吋），如此類推
points_en: Sign: both fists raised forward to the shoulders, backs of the hands to the sky
Patrol by patrol, columns form 2250 mm (90 in) in front of the commander
Patrol leaders at the front, assistants at the rear; scouts 750 mm (30 in) apart in file
The second patrol stands to the left of the first, patrols 750 mm (30 in) apart

check.q_zh: 直行時，小隊長站在哪裏？
check.q_en: Where does the patrol leader stand in columns?
check.why_zh: 手冊：直行時小隊長在最前方，副小隊長在最後方。
check.why_en: Manual: patrol leaders lead each column, assistants bring up the rear.

moves.leader_zh: 所有直行的正前方中央，面向各小隊長
moves.leader_en: Front and centre of all the columns, facing the patrol leaders

points_zh: 手號：兩手握拳向左右兩側提升至與肩齊，前臂向上曲 90 度，手背向外
第一隊在司令前 2250 毫米（90 吋）排成橫排，隊中每名相距 750 毫米（30 吋）
第二隊對齊第一隊，在其後方 1500 毫米（60 吋）排列，如此類推
排與排之間空間較大，方便檢查與講解（開闊排＝排間 1500 毫米，手冊 p.6）
points_en: Sign: both fists raised out to the sides to the shoulders, forearms bent up 90 degrees, backs of the hands outward
The first patrol forms a rank 2250 mm (90 in) in front, scouts 750 mm (30 in) apart
The second patrol aligns behind the first, 1500 mm (60 in) back, and so on
The wider space between ranks suits inspection and instruction (open order = 1500 mm, manual p.6)

check.q_zh: 闊橫排的用途是？
check.q_en: When is open order used?
check.why_zh: 闊橫排讓各排之間有空間，方便領袖檢查與講解。
check.why_en: Open order makes room between ranks for inspection and instruction.

moves.leader_en: Front and centre of the first rank

points_zh: 手號：兩手握拳向前提升至與肩齊，前臂向上彎曲 90 度，手背向前
第一隊在司令前 2250 毫米（90 吋）排成橫排；小隊長在右，副小隊長在左
每名童軍左右相距 750 毫米（30 吋）；第二隊在其後方 750 毫米（30 吋）對齊排列，如此類推
收窄排＝排與排之間 750 毫米（30 吋）；開闊排＝1500 毫米（60 吋）（手冊 p.6）
points_en: Sign: both fists raised forward to the shoulders, forearms bent up 90 degrees, backs of the hands forward
The first patrol forms a rank 2250 mm (90 in) in front; leader on the right, assistant on the left
Scouts 750 mm (30 in) apart; the second patrol aligns 750 mm (30 in) behind, and so on
Close order = 750 mm (30 in) between ranks; open order = 1500 mm (60 in) (manual p.6)

check.q_zh: 窄橫排與闊橫排的分別是？
check.q_en: What changes from open to close order?
check.why_zh: 窄橫排即各排靠攏：排間由 1500 毫米收窄至 750 毫米。
check.why_en: Close order brings the ranks together: 1500 mm narrows to 750 mm.

moves.leader_en: Front and centre of the first rank

points_zh: 手號：雙手直伸向前（包括手掌），左手腕疊於右手腕上，手背向前
在司令前 2250 毫米（90 吋）排列成 U 形，開口向司令
所有童軍面向隊形內；小隊長在右方，副小隊長在左方
隊內左右相距 750 毫米（30 吋），每隊之間約 1500 毫米（60 吋）
points_en: Sign: both hands stretched straight forward, left wrist crossed over the right, backs of the hands forward
The troop forms a U 2250 mm (90 in) in front of the commander, open towards them
Every scout faces inward; patrol leaders on the right, assistants on the left
Scouts 750 mm (30 in) apart, patrols about 1500 mm (60 in) apart

check.q_zh: 馬蹄鐵形的開口向哪個方向？
check.q_en: Which way does the horse shoe open?
check.why_zh: 馬蹄鐵形開口向司令，方便講解與溝通。
check.why_en: The horse shoe opens towards the commander.

moves.leader_zh: U 形開口正前方中央，開口向著領袖
moves.leader_en: Front and centre of the U opening, with the opening towards the leader

points_zh: 手號：雙手手掌互相緊握，右手手背向前，高舉在頭頂上
在司令前 2250 毫米（90 吋）排列成開口正方形
所有童軍面向隊形內；小隊長在右方，副小隊長在左方
隊內左右保持 750 毫米（30 吋），每隊相距約 1500 毫米（60 吋）
points_en: Sign: hands clasped tightly together, back of the right hand forward, held high above the head
The troop forms a square with one side open, 2250 mm (90 in) in front of the commander
Every scout faces inward; patrol leaders on the right, assistants on the left
Scouts 750 mm (30 in) apart, patrols about 1500 mm (60 in) apart

check.q_zh: 開口正方形與馬蹄鐵形的共同點是？
check.q_en: What do the open square and horse shoe have in common?
options_en: Both leave an opening for instruction
check.why_zh: 兩者都是留有開口的圍攏隊形，方便司令講解。
check.why_en: Both are enclosed shapes with an opening for the commander.

moves.leader_zh: 正方形缺口正前方中央，缺口向著領袖
moves.leader_en: Front and centre of the square’s opening, with the opening towards the leader

sections.lead_zh: 集隊之後，隊伍要整理排列——口令 Right—dress!。手冊只提供術語與口令，動作細節跟領袖示範練習。
sections.lead_en: After the fall-in comes the dressing — the command Right—dress! The manual gives the term and the command; the movement itself follows the leader's demonstration.

points_zh: 口令：Right—dress!（向右看齊）；取消口令 As you were（回復先前的姿勢）
看齊（Dressing）的意思：排列時，須與兩旁及前後的隊排成直線（手冊 p.6）
引導翼（Directing Flank）＝全隊用作看齊的那一邊；向右看齊即以右邊為基準
手冊沒有逐部分解動作：手部與腳部動作，跟領袖示範練習
points_en: The command: Right—dress!; the cancelling command is As you were
Dressing means lining up straight with the ranks beside you and in front and behind (manual p.6)
The directing flank is the side the squad dresses by; right dress takes the right as the guide
The manual gives no movement breakdown: the arms and feet follow the leader's demonstration

check.q_zh: 「Dressing（看齊）」的意思是？
check.q_en: What does "dressing" mean?
options_zh: 與兩旁及前後的隊排成直線
options_en: Lining up straight with those beside and in front/behind
check.why_zh: 手冊 p.6：Dressing——排列時，須與兩旁及前後的隊排成直線。
check.why_en: Manual p.6: dressing — lining up straight with the ranks beside and in front/behind.

assess.title_zh: 手冊學完了，請找領袖考核
assess.title_en: The manual is learned — now see your leader
assess.lead_zh: 第 6 項要在領袖面前親身考核。準備好這些：
assess.lead_en: Item 6 is assessed in person, in front of a leader. Be ready with:
points_zh: 基本姿勢與敬禮：立正、稍息、原地向前敬禮
移步與轉法：前、後、左、右移一步，以及向左轉、向右轉、後轉
步法與看齊：原地踏步、齊步、停步、向右看齊
隊形：七類集隊手號，並說出領袖（司令員）的位置
points_en: Positions and salute: alert, stand at ease, saluting to the front
Paces and turns: one pace forward, backward, left and right close; left, right and about turns
Marching and dressing: mark time, quick march, halt, right dress
Formations: the seven fall-in hand signs, including where the leader (commander) stands
assess.after_zh: 考核通過，領袖會給你一個代碼；在下面輸入，遊戲 3 才算完成。想先繼續行程也可以 —— 代碼遲些輸入。
assess.after_en: Pass the assessment and your leader gives you a code — type it in below to finish game 3. Or walk on first: the code can wait.
assess.code_placeholder_en: The code your leader gave you
assess.code_wrong_zh: 代碼不對。請向領袖再問一次。
assess.code_wrong_en: That code does not match. Ask your leader again.
assess.code_hint_zh: 代碼由領袖提供（考核通過後）
assess.code_hint_en: The code comes from your leader, after the assessment

studied.title_zh: 手冊讀完了，訓練場畢業！
studied.title_en: The manual is finished — the drill ground salutes you!
paras_zh: 七類集隊手號和十四個步操動作提示，你都完成了。這只是先在遊戲中學會——真正的步操，要在領袖面前親身做出來。
paras_en: Seven fall-in hand signs and fourteen drill-movement calls, all completed. That is the game learned — real drill is performed in person, in front of your leader.
studied.submitting_zh: 正在記錄你的訓練完成…
studied.save_error_zh: 記錄不到你的完成結果
studied.save_error_en: Your finish could not be saved
studied.save_retry_zh: 請再按一次；仍然不行的話，請找領袖幫忙。
studied.save_retry_en: Press the button again; if it still fails, ask your leader for help.
studied.pass_title_zh: 遊戲 3 通關，第 6 項完成！
studied.pass_title_en: Game 3 cleared — and item 6 with it!
studied.pass_note_zh: 步操的口令和動作都記住了。山下的路繼續走：還有兩個區域，就到沙灘。
studied.pass_note_en: The commands and movements are yours now. The road goes on: two more areas, and the beach is ahead.

labels.review_lead_zh: 這個手號代表「{name}」。記住它，再回機關前。
labels.review_lead_en: This sign calls for “{name}”. Hold it in mind and return to the mechanism.
labels.leave_title_zh: 已通過的手號會記住，機關隨時可以再來
labels.leave_title_en: Your answered signs are kept — the mechanisms wait for you
labels.leave_lead_zh: 離開不會重設進度：回來時翻開你在讀的那一階段。
labels.leave_lead_en: Leaving resets nothing: the cliff reopens on your stage.
labels.prompt_q_zh: 機關顯示的手號，是哪一個隊形？
labels.prompt_q_en: The mechanism shows a hand sign — which formation does it call for?
labels.flip_kicker_zh: 第 {stage} 階段 · 翻卡學手號
labels.flip_lead_zh: 崖壁刻著這一階段的新手號。點一下卡片翻轉，記住手號與隊形的對應。
labels.flip_lead_en: The rock carries this stage's new signs. Tap a card to flip it and learn the formation it calls for.
labels.flip_leader_note_zh: 卡背圖中綠色 ▼ 是領袖（司令員）的位置；隊形排在領袖面前 2250 毫米（90 吋）。
labels.flip_leader_note_en: On each card back, the green ▼ marks the leader (commander); the formation stands 2250 mm (90 in) in front of them.
labels.stage_done_note_zh: 機關啟動，崖壁上又多了一段石階。
labels.stage_done_note_en: The mechanism wakes, and another flight of steps slides out of the rock.
labels.section_done_title_zh: 石階齊了——第 1 節完成！
labels.section_done_title_en: The steps are complete — section 1 done!
labels.section_done_note_zh: 兩段石階全部現身，可以落崖下山了。山下的閱兵場就是第 2 節「步操動作」：先翻卡學口令、打數和動作要點，再在機關叫出口令時按正確動作。
labels.section_done_note_en: Both flights are out, and the cliff is yours to climb down. The parade ground below is section 2, the drill movements: study each command, count and key point on the cards, then press the right movement when the command is called.
labels.move_progress_zh: 第 2 節 · 動作 {done} / {total} · 第 {stage} / {stages} 階段
labels.move_flip_kicker_zh: 第 2 節 · 第 {stage} 階段 · 翻卡學步操動作
labels.move_flip_kicker_en: Section 2 · stage {stage} · study the movement cards
labels.move_flip_lead_zh: 先記住卡面口令及對應動作，再翻卡看打數和動作要點；之後機關叫出口令，你要按出正確動作。
labels.move_flip_lead_en: Learn the command on each card front and the movement it calls for, then flip the card for its count and key points. Next, press the right movement when the mechanism calls the command.
labels.pace_card_note_zh: 四個方向共用同一基本姿勢：身體正面向前，只移一步，完成後回復立正。左／右橫移一步為 300 毫米；前／後移步跟領袖示範練習。
labels.pace_card_note_en: All four directions share the same basics: stay square to the front, move one pace only, and finish at attention. One side pace is 300 mm; forward and backward pacing follows the leader’s demonstration.
labels.move_prompt_kicker_zh: 第 2 節 · 步操動作 · 第 {stage} / {stages} 階段
labels.move_prompt_q_zh: 聽到這個口令，要做哪一個動作？
labels.move_prompt_q_en: On this command, which movement do you make?
labels.move_review_lead_zh: 這個口令要做「{name}」。看清口令、打數和動作要點，再回閱兵場。
labels.move_review_lead_en: This command calls for “{name}”. Read the command, count and key points, then return to the parade ground.
labels.move_stage_done_note_zh: 閱兵場升起一面訓練旗；這一階段的口令和動作已經完成。
labels.move_stage_done_note_en: A training flag rises over the parade ground; this stage’s commands and movements are complete.
labels.move_finish_zh: 完成第 2 節，記錄訓練 →
labels.move_finish_en: Finish section 2 and record the training →
labels.section2_start_zh: 落到閱兵場，開始第 2 節 →
labels.section2_start_en: Climb down to the parade ground — start section 2 →
